title: Size bounded by encoding length
statement: Let $C$ be a finite Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, gates in topological order, and a designated output vertex. The size of $C$ is at most the length of its encoding.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a DAG circuit with $n$ inputs, gates in topological order, and a valid designated output
